sourceEvidence.title: Engineering Project Leader
sourceEvidence.quote: The Engineering Project Leader (EPL) provides technical leadership and coordination across all engineering activities within a program, bridging program management and engineering execution. The EPL leads a multidisciplinary engineering team through the full product development lifecycle, ensuring technical deliverables are completed on time, within budget, and to the required quality and performance standards. The EPL is accountable for planning, coordinating, assessing, and controlling engineering execution across the product lifecycle, including requirements definition and decomposition, system and product development, integration and testing, engineering builds, system transition, and product release. This role ensures alignment to customer and OEM requirements while driving risk-informed, system-level decisions and successful transition of products into manufacturing and operations.
